name: mod-pack
description: A pack of small Claude Code mods that share the band above the prompt without overwriting each other. Turn each one on or off with /mods.

tokenWeather.title: Token Weather
tokenWeather.description: Show the context-window forecast above the prompt.

cacheKeeper.title: Cache Keeper
cacheKeeper.description: Show a countdown of how long the prompt cache stays warm after the last response, with a compact button, a warning toast in the last 5 minutes, and a cold notice. Costs no model tokens.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long Claude Code's prompt cache lives, for Cache Keeper's countdown. Anthropic documents 60 for the main conversation on a Claude subscription within plan usage, and 5 on an API key, a cloud provider, or usage credits. Mod-pack cannot read which one you have: set 5 there. A value that is not between 0 and 1440 counts as 60.

blastRadius.title: Blast Radius
blastRadius.description: Ask Proceed or Cancel, with a preview of what would change, before Claude runs a risky shell command (rm -rf, git reset --hard, git push --force, ...). A non-interactive run denies those commands. Costs no model tokens.

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: Let features that can play a sound do so. Off by default. Claude Code plays plugin sound only where it has a player (macOS).
